direct1.limitation: Switch values written or read back by the host are stimulus, not ROM observations. Each probe follows a different 3-second reference; every reference frame and address/wire code is checked in both fresh runs. The two cabinet flipper inputs 84 and 82 are copied to matrix addresses 15 and 16. Output transitions establish emulator behavior, not physical fitment, polarity, quantity, or location. The raw solenoid sequence includes relay 10 transitions while an L-bank coil is selected; the selected driver cycle is 1,25,2,26,3,27,4,28,5,29,6,30,7,31,8,32,9,10,11,12,13,14,15,16; 17-22 are not tested, and absence is not proof of an unused output. Names retain the decoder glyphs; 0/O and 5/S share segments, while unknown glyphs remain ?. Segments 0x0006 and 0x0867 decode as 1 and 9.
